description: This Python script is responsible for fetching and updating VNDK snapshot versions according to specified branch mappings. It includes functions for argument parsing, updating snapshots for given versions, and the main execution logic. The script interacts with external modules 'update' and 'utils' for performing updates and configuration.

methods.name: fetch_and_update_snapshots(versions, args)
methods.description: Iterates through provided VNDK versions, verifies their validity, retrieves the latest bid for each branch, and triggers the update process.

methods.name: get_args(parser)
methods.description: Sets up and parses command line arguments related to VNDK versions, fetch options, and logging verbosity.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main entry point which orchestrates argument parsing, logging configuration, and initiates snapshot updates based on user inputs.
